name: doneguard
description: Verify that Codex has evidence for completion before a coding task ends.

interface.shortDescription: Check completion evidence before Codex stops.
interface.longDescription: DoneGuard maps code and declared non-code inputs to structured verification rules, validates fresh artifacts, records language-aware scan completeness, and uses budgeted persistent Merkle fingerprints before Codex finishes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show me how DoneGuard is configured for this project and explain its latest completion check.
